annotations.title: Apps a Meta ad account can promote

description: The mobile apps a Meta ad account may promote in app-install ads, with their platforms and store links. Pass applicationId to also read Meta's iOS 14 campaign limits for that app on this account (how many iOS 14+ campaigns it may run); that read does not prove the app is set up for iOS promotion. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared

applicationId.description: one app id: also read its iOS 14 campaign limits

businessId.description: limit to apps of this business
